I have the authority to set the facilitator, participation rules, and preparation standards for this forum. Before I finalize the new arrangement, I want to follow our normal practice of asking the people who participate in the forum and HR to recommend concrete changes. So I'd like to hear from each of you — what specific improvements would you recommend for how this forum operates?
